description.value: Osteria Povera is an Italian restaurant in Port Moody inspired by cucina povera, the Puglian tradition of making great food from simple, high-quality ingredients. The kitchen focuses on fresh tomatoes, homemade pasta, and house-made pomodoro sauce. Situated on Clarke Street, it offers both lunch and dinner service with walk-ins welcome alongside reservations.

address.value: 2331 Clarke St, Port Moody, BC V3H 1Y9
